clue.text: Anticipate no relaxation in collapse

indicators.note: the word for no and the word for relaxation go inside the word for collapse

parts.note: to collapse is to fall
no as nothing, the zero-shaped letter O
relaxation is rest

explanation.surface: Someone braces for a breakdown, expecting no let-up at all.
explanation.definitionFit: To forestall is to act ahead of something, preventing it by anticipating it.

clue.text: Judge's ruling thick bundle of notes is 500 short

parts.note: thick means fat

indicators.note: 500 short says the bundle is lacking the Roman numeral for five hundred

parts.note: a wad is a roll or bundle of banknotes
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: A judge's verdict on a fat wad of cash that turns out 500 light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' takes away the letter that 500 stands for. The judge here is an Islamic legal scholar, not a courtroom judge.
explanation.definitionFit: A fatwa is a ruling issued by an Islamic legal scholar or judge.

clue.text: Hearing precise travel directions, but unable to move

indicators.note: hearing tells us the phrase is judged by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: being routed to the spot is being given exact directions to a place

explanation.surface: Someone listens to exact directions but finds themselves stuck fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Rooted to the spot is an idiom for frozen still, unable to move from fear or surprise.

clue.text: Disease on farm is shocking

definitions.meaning: a nervous disorder of livestock causing them to stumble
something that astounds someone is shocking them

explanation.definitionFit: The name is both a livestock disease and the verb for astonishing someone.

clue.text: Chap can dynamite houses

indicators.note: the words can dynamite house, or contain, the answer within them

explanation.surface: A fellow can blow buildings up with explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: Andy is a man's name, and crosswords treat any man's name as a chap.

clue.text: Killed — by drowning?

parts.note: killed off, and drowning would be a death by liquid

explanation.definitionFit: To liquidate an enemy is to kill them; the playful reading is turned to liquid.

clue.text: Prepare for role as royal attendant

definitions.meaning: to prepare a person for a role, train them up
an officer of the royal household

explanation.surface: Someone gets ready for a part playing a servant at court.
explanation.definitionFit: To groom is to prepare someone; a groom is also an officer serving the monarch.

clue.text: Works away, and departs wreathed in smiles

indicators.note: the letter for departs is surrounded by the smiles word, as if wrapped

parts.note: smiles are grins
D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: Someone toils on, then leaves beaming.
explanation.definitionFit: One who grinds labours steadily at dull work, so grinds means works away.

clue.text: Rarely do we hear one offender, doubly low, ending in prison

indicators.note: the question asks how the phrase sounds when spoken

parts.note: an offender is a sinner, so one sinner
low read two ways: low in spirits is blue, and a cow lows, that is, moos
low read two ways: low in spirits is blue, and a cow lows, that is, moos

indicators.note: only the final letter of prison is taken

parts.note: only its final letter is used

explanation.surface: A rare sight: a single criminal, deeply depressed, winding up in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: One sinner said aloud gives ONCE IN A; BLUE and MOO are the two senses of low.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for something happening hardly ever is a synonym for rarely.

clue.text: County railway opened by key found in public office

parts.note: Mayo is a county in Ireland

indicators.note: the railway abbreviation is split open and the key goes in

parts.note: Alt is a key on a computer keyboard

explanation.surface: A county's rail line gets unlocked by a key discovered in a government building.
explanation.definitionFit: A mayoralty is the office held by a mayor, a public post.

clue.text: Self-confessed drug-taker in discotheque — many busted

indicators.note: busted means broken up, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Many people at a nightclub are arrested for drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: The writer of Confessions of an English Opium-Eater; busted suggests a drugs raid.
explanation.definitionFit: The essayist publicly confessed his opium addiction in his famous memoir.

clue.text: Just up from bed, off to speak

indicators.note: to speak says the word for off is spoken, giving a word with the same sound

parts.note: off means away, as in gone

explanation.surface: Someone just out of bed sets off to talk.
explanation.walkthrough: The bed is the seabed: an anchor is aweigh when just lifted from it.
explanation.definitionFit: An anchor is aweigh when it has just been raised clear of the sea floor.

clue.text: I broke one on the roof that's more awkward to handle

indicators.note: I breaks into the musician's word, splitting it

parts.note: the Fiddler on the Roof, the musical's title figure

explanation.surface: I smashed a tile on the roof that was tricky to manage.
explanation.definitionFit: Fiddly means awkward to handle, and this is its comparative form.

clue.text: Disease causing absence of the French in Georgian city

indicators.note: the two pieces are put inside the city name

parts.note: Bath is an English city famous for Georgian architecture
absence is lack
de is French for of

explanation.surface: An illness breaks out because the French have left a city in Georgia.
explanation.walkthrough: Georgian points to the US state, but means the eighteenth-century style of Bath.
explanation.definitionFit: The fourteenth-century plague pandemic was a disease known by this name.

clue.text: In Saturn trip, a piece of seaweed is source of energy

indicators.note: the seaweed piece goes inside the rearranged planet name
trip as stumble suggests the planet's letters fall into a new order

parts.note: a single alga is one of the algae, a piece of seaweed

explanation.surface: A space voyage to Saturn powered by seaweed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trip' looks like part of the space-travel picture, but it is the signal to rearrange the planet's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: This fossil fuel of methane is a major source of energy.

clue.text: Sunshine changed temperature in army building

indicators.note: changed says the letters of sunshine are rearranged

explanation.surface: Sunshine altered the temperature in a barracks.
explanation.definitionFit: A Nissen hut is a prefabricated corrugated-iron shelter built for the army.

clue.text: Baby's start: one piercing cry

indicators.note: the start of the word is its first letter

parts.note: an awl is a tool that pierces holes

explanation.surface: A baby's first act is a piercing cry.
explanation.definitionFit: To bawl is to cry loudly.

clue.text: Creative type making opening in wrought iron

indicators.note: the opening goes inside the worked letters
wrought means worked or shaped, so the letters of iron are reworked

parts.note: a vent is an opening

explanation.surface: An artist makes a gap in a piece of wrought iron.
explanation.definitionFit: An inventor is someone creative who devises new things.

clue.text: Block a burrow

definitions.meaning: a squared paving stone or block of stone

explanation.definitionFit: Sett names both a paving stone and a badger's burrow.

clue.text: Put sport on TV: full instructions for shooting here

indicators.note: in an across answer, putting one thing on another places it after

parts.note: the TV is the screen
sport means play

explanation.surface: Broadcast a game on television, with full directions for filming.
explanation.definitionFit: A screenplay is the script giving complete directions for filming a movie.

clue.text: Harness strap put round horse in the old country

indicators.note: the strap word is placed around the horse letter

parts.note: a trace is a strap linking a horse to a cart
H is slang for heroin, itself called horse

explanation.surface: A harness strap is fitted around a horse in a bygone land.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrace was an ancient region in the Balkans, a country of antiquity.

clue.text: Observes hell's endless? A sight more comfortable with this

definitions.text: A sight more comfortable with this

parts.note: observes means eyes

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Hades is the underworld or hell

explanation.surface: Someone sees hell is infinite, and things look better with a visor.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyeshade is a visor shielding the eyes, so seeing becomes easier.

clue.text: Sort of gene I've lost in inactive period

indicators.note: lost says the letters of I've are removed

parts.note: a recessive gene is one kind of gene

explanation.surface: A kind of gene is lost during a dormant stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess is a break, a period when activity is suspended.

clue.text: Riddle is taken up by our mother

indicators.note: in a down answer taken up means read upwards, reversing

parts.note: Eve is the mother of all humanity in Genesis

explanation.surface: A puzzle is brought up by a mother.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a coarse sieve, and to riddle soil is to sift it.

clue.text: Refusal to dip into a new, prolific author

indicators.note: the refusal dips into, so sits inside, the other pieces

parts.note: a refusal is a no

explanation.surface: A refusal to read a novel by a productive writer.
explanation.walkthrough: Anon, short for anonymous, is credited with countless works.
explanation.definitionFit: Anonymous is credited with countless poems and sayings, making that unnamed writer prolific.

clue.text: Not really expect family quarrel over Zenda royalties?

parts.note: Anthony Hope wrote The Prisoner of Zenda, so a family row over his earnings would be Hope versus Hope

explanation.surface: Relatives fight over earnings from a famous adventure novel.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep wishing despite little chance is the idiom for not really expecting success.

clue.text: It's right to hold a championship

definitions.meaning: legal ownership, the right to hold property
a sporting crown, as in world champion status

explanation.surface: Something gives a lawful claim to a championship.
explanation.definitionFit: A title is both legal ownership of property and a sporting championship.

clue.text: On back rank, to hide king, castle away from centre? It's check

parts.note: hind means back, as in hind legs

indicators.note: to hide the king is to remove its letter from view

parts.note: rank is taken as written before the king goes
K is the chess abbreviation for king

indicators.note: away from centre means the middle letters are removed, leaving the ends

explanation.surface: A chess move: on the back rank, shielding the king, castling to the side gives check.
explanation.definitionFit: A hindrance is something that checks or obstructs progress.
